commitResults.messageBody:
The command field does not retain previously entered commands, so keyboard-heavy users must retype repeated operations.

Add session-only history navigation with the up and down arrow keys, preserve unfinished drafts, and avoid consecutive duplicate entries. Document the new shortcuts and cover the navigation behaviour with focused unit tests.

The initial command history tests cover the main navigation path but not boundary or empty-history behaviour.

Add tests for empty history, navigation limits, draft preservation, reset behaviour, and non-consecutive duplicates. Preserve typed command text when the down arrow is pressed before any history exists.

CommandBox had no direct unit coverage, leaving command execution, failure feedback, focus, and keyboard history handling unverified.

Add JavaFX-thread tests for successful and empty commands, command and parse failures, error-style reset behaviour, modifier handling, history navigation, focus, and caret placement. Exercise the installed key handler directly to keep the tests deterministic.

commitResults.messageTitle: Replace JavaFX tests with pure tests
commitResults.messageBody:
CommandBox UI tests require a graphical display and fail when Ubuntu runs the suite headlessly.

Remove the JavaFX-dependent tests and expand the no-UI CommandHistory tests to cover first insertion, intermediate navigation, history boundaries, draft restoration, and duplicate handling. Keep the coverage checks compatible with headless environments.

CommandBox behaviour depended directly on JavaFX controls, so its tests required a graphical display and were unreliable on headless Ubuntu runners.

Move command execution, history navigation, modifier handling, and history resets into a pure collaborator. Keep CommandBox as a thin JavaFX adapter and cover the extracted behaviour with display-independent unit tests.

Keep headless coverage focused on the command-box behaviour that can be
exercised without starting the JavaFX toolkit. Exclude the UI adapter and
its nested executor from both JaCoCo reports while documenting that the
behaviour is covered by CommandBoxLogicTest.
Update find command’s invalid-format error message
Prevent excessive error message overflow in feedback box

commitResults.messageTitle: Add student notes and headless tests
commitResults.messageBody:
Student records cannot store tutoring-specific notes, and the automated suite includes JavaFX UI tests that require a graphical display or are skipped in headless environments.

Add optional r/ notes with validation, persistence, UI display, and user documentation. Remove JavaFX-dependent tests and fixtures, and exclude JavaFX UI and application-entry code from JaCoCo coverage.

Keep the automated suite focused on headless application logic so it runs reliably in CI while UI behaviour remains suitable for manual testing.

current list context.

Add the show INDEX command and a dimmed, scrollable detail modal that
uses the currently displayed order and presents all available fields.

Harden null and invalid-input handling, and add non-UI unit and
integration coverage for the command and result flow.
Document TutorRoster undo and redo

The clear command is present but unavailable because the parser does not
register it. Enable strict no-argument parsing and reset the display

headless functional tests, and document the command.
Enable the clear command

The autocomplete popup is positioned below the command field, which
places it at the bottom of the window. Position it above the field using
the popup preferred height so the complete menu remains visible.

The autocomplete popup can render taller than its initial preferred-height
measurement, allowing its lower rows to pass the application boundary.
Enable popup auto-fixing, remeasure after rendering, and clamp its vertical
position to the window bounds.

A stale rendered-height measurement moves shorter menus too far above the
command field after the suggestion list changes. Use the freshly computed
preferred height for each update so the menu remains attached.

The popup height is not final when the menu first moves, which changes the
gap between its bottom border and the input bar. Reposition it after the
JavaFX layout pulse and ignore stale updates from older menu contents.

Add a small visual gap between the autocomplete menu and the input bar
while preserving their shared left alignment.

Anchor the suggestion popup to the full command bar instead of the text
field, and use the current menu height when restoring its vertical gap.

Use the shown popup window height for the delayed vertical adjustment and
reapply the input bar X coordinate so the borders remain aligned.

Edit commands replace multi-value fields with s/ and t/ while also
supporting +s/, -s/, +t/, and -t/ for incremental updates. Preserve
subject uniqueness and validate the resulting collections before saving.

Add defensive null checks at parser, utility, and descriptor boundaries.
Expand non-FXUI tests and configure JaCoCo to exclude UI and application
entry-point classes while enforcing line and branch coverage thresholds.
Document the edit syntax and coverage workflow.

Support multi-value edit operations
Integrate the address field
